rules.sentence: Parkinsonism is a clinical syndrome characterised by bradykinesia: slowness of movement, hypokinesia: reduced movement, akinesia: loss of movement, rigidity: increased resistance to passive extension and flexion, tremor: mainly resting.
Idiopathic Parkinson's disease consists of Parkinsonism characterised pathologically by neuronal loss with Lewy bodies in the substantia nigra.
